sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a home fixture against a struggling Alsager side currently bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their unbeaten streak further.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a critical away trip to Dawley Town (15:00 Saturday), a chance to stay within striking distance of leaders Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall (15:00 Saturday) in a meeting of mid-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, are at home to Wednesfield Community (15:00 Saturday). Bilston Town host Foley Meir (15:00 Saturday) in a clash between in-form sides — Bilston enter the week on a strong run including recent wins, while Foley Meir have also shown solid form. Barnton welcome Shawbury United (15:00 Saturday), with Shawbury struggling on a poor run of five losses in their last six. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills (15:00 Saturday) in a battle of lower-mid-table teams. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (15:00 Saturday) in a fixture between two of the division's weakest performers. Brereton Social are at home to rock-bottom Widnes Town (15:00 Saturday), with Widnes yet to win a game this season. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath (15:00 Saturday) in a match between sides near the bottom of the table.
